name: Bogdan Rzońca - § 17 - Am 18
title: REPORT on the annual report on the activities of the European Ombudsman in 2024
part_text: 17. Stresses that Frontex’s primary mission must be the prevention of deaths at sea, fully and consistently complying with relevant international human rights law; stresses that under the applicable EU and international legal framework, Member States are obliged to render assistance to any vessel or person in distress at sea, regardless of the nationality or status of the person or the circumstances in which that person is found;
